edition: Rahlfs–Hanhart, second revised edition (2006), German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User authorized provisional continuation with Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006; Göttingen not obtained.
scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 is the user-authorized provisional base. The listed running-text passages were inspected selectively; this is not a new complete Greek collation. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent linguistic and textual-critical review, and human read-aloud review remain pending.
historical_records: Earlier Law study and existing chapter notes were consulted as historical evidence, not proof of new Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Retain seventy-five descendants, On/City of the Sun and the midwives' houses. Restore the doubled intensifier at 1:7 and 1:12: exceedingly, exceedingly strong. This is a documented correction from the inspected running text, not a new manuscript choice.
chapters.pending: The syntax of 1:19–21 and personal-name forms need independent review.

chapters.decision: Retain the basket, bitumen-pitch, Moses' water naming, Gershom alone in 2:22 and God becoming known in 2:25. Ordinary dialogue uses you/your.
chapters.pending: Review the material term in 2:3 and the Jethro/Reuel/Zipporah name index.

chapters.decision: Retain the One Who Is, repeated divine names, all seven peoples and the neighbour/fellow-lodger wording. The repeated source clauses have not been harmonized to another stream.
chapters.pending: Independent review of divine-name language and its explanation.

chapters.decision: Direct prayer retains Thee/Thou/Thy; God's speech to Moses uses you/your. Keep the angel, stone, unidentified feet and repeated blood statement in 4:24–26 without inserting a named referent.
chapters.pending: Priority review: the elliptical phrase in 4:16 and the syntax and referents of 4:24–26.

chapters.decision: Retain the feast, death or slaughter, smell and sword images. Moses' prayer at 5:22–23 retains Thou/Thy; speech to Pharaoh and the officials uses you/your.
chapters.pending: Review the legal/social vocabulary and the complaint's syntax.

chapters.decision: Retain your covenant at 6:5 (Greek plural address), Kohath's 130 years, Amram's 132 years, Jochebed's relationship, Miriam and the two named sons in 6:22.
chapters.pending: Genealogical, numerical and divine-name review.

chapters.decision: Retain a god to Pharaoh, the ages eighty/eighty-three, the singular he in 7:7, dragon in the sign and the existing distinctions in hardening vocabulary.
chapters.pending: Lexical review of dragon/serpent and the hardening verbs.

chapters.decision: Retain the appointed time, houses, finger of God, repeated Lord, dogflies and distinction wording. No insect identification has been silently substituted.
chapters.pending: Plague terminology and singular/plural address in the dialogue.

chapters.decision: Retain the repeated human/animal scope, the future threat, the passive preservation language and the strong hail description.
chapters.pending: Independent review of the tense and force of 9:15–16.

chapters.decision: Retain the south wind, sea wind, darkness/gloom/tempest and household and offering distinctions. Ordinary speech including Pharaoh's commands uses you/your.
chapters.pending: Review the rhetorical question in 10:7 and wind terminology.

chapters.decision: Retain the secret instruction, lending language, dog's tongue image and Pharaoh's servants. Smooth the departure speech without deleting its clauses.
chapters.pending: Review the lending verb and rhetorical imagery.

chapters.decision: Retain both bone prohibitions, blood beside the door, shelter language, mixed multitude, and the 430-year Egypt-and-Canaan reading. Keep slavery and resident-foreigner distinctions explicit.
chapters.pending: Passover terminology, legal status and the chronological reading require specialist review.

chapters.decision: Retain six days in 13:6 and seven in 13:7, the donkey redemption wording and the fifth generation. No harmonization of these readings.
chapters.pending: Review firstborn/redemption terms and fifth-generation wording.

chapters.decision: Retain the south wind, darkness and gloom, and bound axles. Keep lift up with your staff at 14:16 provisionally; in at 14:31 supplies an English connection while retaining the great-hand image.
chapters.pending: Priority review of the elliptical staff command in 14:16 and the construction in 14:31.

chapters.decision: The song's line breaks, repeated refrain, right-hand imagery, wrath and beyond remain. Direct address uses Thou/Thee/Thy. At 15:16 restore the second possessive: this people of Thine. At 15:13 this people of Thine retains the existing possessive in smoother English. The PDF names this chapter as a voice benchmark but does not supply an accepted full chapter text.
chapters.pending: Independent review of holy ones/holiness (15:11), comfort and dwelling (15:13), song rhythm and apparatus.

chapters.decision: Retain Man, the golden jar, Phoenicia and the measure wording. You in 16:28–29 addresses the community in the plural despite the introductory address to Moses. Keep gathering and Sabbath repetitions.
chapters.pending: Review the measure in 16:36 and food/material terms.

chapters.decision: Retain the staff, rock, place names and hidden hand. Draw up for battle makes the military command in 17:9 natural without changing its action.
chapters.pending: Priority review of the hidden-hand expression in 17:16.

chapters.decision: Retain the reported message, after the next day and the difficult pronouns in 18:11. Represent the people in matters pertaining to God at 18:19 makes the contextual role explicit in English.
chapters.pending: Review 18:11's referents, 18:13's time expression and the role phrase in 18:19.

chapters.decision: Keep royal priesthood, the departure of sounds/trumpets/cloud, the people's astonishment and the Lord departing in 19:22. Moses' direct address to God in 19:23 retains Thou; quoted commands to people use ordinary address.
chapters.pending: Review boundary language and the differing verbs in 19:22 and 19:24.

chapters.decision: Retain the Greek commandment order: adultery, theft, murder in 20:13–15. Keep saw the sound at 20:18, the repeated name in 20:24 and the original plural/singular movement; the commandments principally address a singular you, while 20:22–24 includes plural community address.
chapters.pending: Legal and literary review, including the sensory image in 20:18.

chapters.decision: Modernize conditional verbs without changing legal conditions or remedies. Retain female slaves in 21:7, the formed/unformed distinction in 21:22–23, thirty didrachmas and the theft law at 21:37.
chapters.pending: Priority legal/lexical review of 21:8–11, 17 and 22–23. No modern legal or moral application is added to Scripture.

chapters.decision: Retain the difficult pronouns and death wording in 22:2, before/through God in adjudication, taking the owner to the prey, plural sorcerers and gods/rulers at 22:27. Conditional verbs and ordinary address are made natural.
chapters.pending: Priority review of 22:2's subjects, the judicial terminology and 22:27.

chapters.decision: Keep the expanded covenant wording in 23:22, all named peoples, wine, hornets and Euphrates. You in 23:22 moves between plural community address and singular address; the repetitions are preserved. Angel pronouns remain lower case without deciding an identification.
chapters.pending: Review the expanded text against the full apparatus and confirm all singular/plural shifts.

chapters.decision: Retain seeing the place where God stood, the chosen men not missing, their appearance in God's place, the plural they said and Joshua ascending with Moses.
chapters.pending: Priority review of the vision language and the grammar in 24:10–11.

chapters.decision: Preserve blue skins, decay-resistant wood, the table of pure gold and the lampstand details. Remove the accidental duplicated from in 25:22. No verse 25:6 is inserted.
chapters.pending: Technical terms, stones, propitiatory cover and lampstand construction need specialist review.

chapters.decision: Retain north/south orientation, the singular post formulations, curtain repetitions and screening the ark with the veil. Commands to Moses use you/your; measurements are unchanged.
chapters.pending: Architectural vocabulary and the arrangement of curtains, posts and bars.

chapters.decision: Preserve the source's directions and dimensions, including fifteen/twenty cubits high and a hundred by a hundred. They have not been corrected to a familiar reconstruction.
chapters.pending: Priority architectural and textual review of directions and dimensions in 27:9–18.

chapters.decision: Retain emeralds, Manifestation and Truth, gold pomegranates, the sound, removal of sins and filling the hands. Preserve 28:29a and the absence of separate 28:23–28.
chapters.pending: Priestly dress, gemstones, oracle-piece terminology and the consecration idiom.

chapters.decision: Retain the two bread types, on the basket, the hand/foot extremities, day of purification and being called upon. At 29:30 divide the long relative construction into two linked clauses without changing the priest or the seven days.
chapters.pending: Consecration terms and the meaning of 29:43. Review the source's from-there expression at 29:42, not separately expressed in the inherited English.

chapters.decision: Retain didrachma/obols in the census and shekels in the oil recipe, iris, the repeated washing instruction and plural they shall make at 30:35.
chapters.pending: Aromatic substances and census terminology. Review the source's from-there expression in 30:6, not separately expressed in the inherited English.

chapters.decision: Retain Eliab, plural altars and ceased and rested. Preserve the inherited divine Spirit wording without treating capitalization as a resolution of theological questions.
chapters.pending: Name-index, Spirit vocabulary and Sabbath syntax.

chapters.decision: Retain wives/daughters, singular he in 32:4 and 32:6, wine-song, scattered, filled hands and the repeated forgiveness command. Direct prayer uses Thyself; human speech uses you. No separate 32:9 is inserted.
chapters.pending: Priority review of 32:18, 25, 29 and the time expression in 32:30.

chapters.decision: Retain the six peoples of 33:2, the different blow and clothing language, reveal Thyself, singular me in 33:15 and what is behind Me. Quoted divine speech inside Moses' prayer uses you; Moses addresses God as Thou/Thee/Thy.
chapters.pending: Priority review of presence, revelation and knowledge language in 33:12–23.

chapters.decision: Retain righteousness, burning carved images, both marriage directions, paying a beast's value, middle of the year and offer a lamb in milk. Keep glorified facial appearance. Thou shalt in 34:9 is retained because Moses addresses God.
chapters.pending: Covenant vocabulary, 34:22 and 26, and the glorification language.

chapters.decision: Retain I am the Lord in 35:3, the men bringing from the women, the shorter materials list, emeralds and Eliab. Preserve 35:12a and the existing absent verse labels.
chapters.pending: Offering syntax, names and material terms.

chapters.decision: Retain the Greek sequence beginning the garments at 36:8, emeralds, and the shifts between they and he. Smooth only the placement of had been given in 36:1; the other English wording already reads naturally.
chapters.pending: Technical dress vocabulary and singular/plural workmanship clauses.

chapters.decision: The English wording is retained after review. Keep a hundred by a hundred, height and breadth, Ithamar and Eliab, and this chapter's Greek arrangement.
chapters.pending: Dimensions, Levite service and craft terminology.

chapters.decision: Clarify the gold lampstand sentence while retaining the present gives light. Keep the pure-gold table, Korah censers and the repeated fasting description; do not harmonize their chronology or details.
chapters.pending: Priority review of 38:16, 18, 20, 22 and 26, including furniture terms and referents.

chapters.decision: The English wording is retained after review. Keep all quantities, drachma/shekel distinctions, gilded capitals, leftover materials and repeated statements of completion.
chapters.pending: Independent numerical and technical audit, including the silver/gilding wording in 39:5.

chapters.decision: Retain new-moon dating, poles beneath the ark, all completion repetitions and the cloud/fire conclusion. Commands use you. Keep all existing gaps in verse numbering.
chapters.pending: Review the elliptical instruction at 40:8 and the furniture/dating terms.
